environment.description: Application deployed identically on EC2 behind ALB, but the ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group (priority 1, action: BLOCK) with two rules evaluated in order. Rule 1: SizeConstraint on QueryString with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 128 bytes (blocks requests where total query string exceeds 128 bytes). Rule 2: RegexPatternSet match on UriPath targeting '/api/users/search' combined with a ByteMatchStatement on SingleQueryArgument 'q' searching for the byte sequence 0x27 (single quote) with TextTransformation URL_DECODE followed by TextTransformation HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, action BLOCK. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rules are actively evaluating.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, associated WAFv2 Web ACL
config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound
